bullets_en: In Kolkata, the BJP redraws power lines.
Will Taiwan vote to revive nuclear power – and why does that matter for AI?.
Congress says BJP wants to change Constitution, compromised CEC will redraw LS seats.
Support to Bill may not automatically lead DMK to NDA, but will open alignment path.
CJI had sought probe against HC judge. He is J’khand acting CJ now.
bullets_ur: Kolkata mein BJP ne power lines ka naqsha dobarah tayar kar diya hai.
Kya Taiwan nuclear power bahal karne ke liye vote dega – aur AI ke liye yeh kyun ahem hai?
Congress ka kehna hai ke BJP Aaeen badalna chahti hai, mutasir CEC LS seats ka naqsha dobarah banaye ga.
Bill ki himayat se DMK khud-ba-khud NDA mein nahi jaye gi, lekin ittehad ka rasta khul jaye ga.
CJI ne HC judge ke khilaf tehqeeq mangi thi. Woh ab Jharkhand ke acting CJ hain.
